analysis.title: Delek US Holdings (DK): First Take: Earnings Beat Driven By Margin Realizations; Focus on Return of Capital & Macro Outlook on Call
key_insights: DK reported 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA (excluding SRE impact) of ~$1,038 mn vs GS estimate of $847 mn, a ~$191 mn beat.
Adjusted EPS was $10.53 vs GS estimate of $7.73, a $2.80 beat.

Refining drove the beat: unit gross margins were higher than GS estimates at all four refineries (El Dorado, Krotz Springs, Tyler, Big Spring) while unit opex was roughly in line. Total refining segment EBITDA was $999.8 mn vs GS $772.3 mn.
Delek Logistics adjusted EBITDA was $142.9 mn vs GS $145.0 mn, roughly in line. Corporate adjusted EBITDA was ($104.6) mn vs GS ($70.0) mn, less favorable than estimated.
DK repurchased $50 mn of shares in the quarter vs GS estimate of $35 mn. In 4Q26 it expects to repurchase up to $100 mn of shares and repay the outstanding $850 mn Term Loan.
The company raised its end-of-period annual run-rate cash flow improvement guidance to at least $250 mn and raised annual DKL EBITDA guidance to $530-$560 mn.
DK expects $425 mn of net small refinery exemption (SRE) proceeds in 4Q26.

GS key questions for the call: RIN monetization beyond the $425 mn net SRE proceeds, shareholder returns and buybacks into 2027, progress on SOTP unlock and further economic separation from DKL, and the refining margin outlook and commercial capability improvements.
GS rates DK Buy with a 6-month price target of $97 (SOTP 85%, M&A 15%), implying 55.2% upside from the $62.49 close on 5 Nov 2026.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA of ~$1,038 mn beat GS's $847 mn on higher refining unit margins. Price target of $97 is SOTP-based (85%) plus M&A (15%) and implies 55.2% upside from $62.49.

Throughput actual vs GS (bpd): Tyler 74,817 vs 75,000, El Dorado 80,690 vs 82,400, Krotz Springs 86,078 vs 81,400, Big Spring 74,706 vs 71,540. Opex per barrel was roughly in line.
Logistics EBITDA $142.9 mn vs GS $145.0 mn. Corporate ($104.6) mn vs GS ($70.0) mn. Interest expense ($73.4) mn vs GS ($85.0) mn.
GS forecasts (estimates): 4Q26E EPS $5.31, FY26E EPS $15.69, FY27E EPS $8.79, FY28E EPS $2.84. FY26E EBITDA $2,106.5 mn.

Guidance: run-rate cash flow improvements raised to at least $250 mn, DKL annual EBITDA guidance raised to $530-$560 mn, 4Q26 buyback of up to $100 mn, $850 mn Term Loan to be repaid, $425 mn net SRE proceeds expected in 4Q26.
